# Web: bot "Repositories" settings section

## What to build

Add a **Repositories** section to the bot settings panel on web (desktop uses the same UI) so the bot owner can choose which repositories the bot may work in (PRD user story 3).

- **Layout:** a `SectionHeading`-labelled group in the bot's Advanced tab. It lists the bound repositories as rows, each with a remove (X) button. An add control lists the repositories that the user's code-host connections can reach.
- **Saving:** every change calls `bots.repositories.set` with the full new list.
- **No computer:** when the deployment has no computer (`me.sandboxProvider` is `"none"` or `""`), show the single line **"This bot needs a computer to use repositories."** and disable the controls. This is the only state where explanatory copy appears.
- **No connections:** when the user has none, the add control is replaced by a link button labelled "Connections" that opens `?settings=connections`.

New copy, to be justified in the PR: "Repositories" (section label), "This bot needs a computer to use repositories." (no-computer state only), "Add repository" (accessible name of the add control).

Already in the codebase:
- `bots.repositories.list({ botId })` returns `{ repositories: [{ id, connectionId, provider: "github"|"gitlab", hostRepoId, fullPath, defaultBranch, branchPrefix }] }`.
- `bots.repositories.set({ botId, repositories: [{ connectionId, hostRepoId }] })` returns the same shape.
- `codeHosts.connections.list` returns `[{ id, provider, baseUrl, authKind, label, createdAt }]`.
- `codeHosts.repositories.list({ connectionId, query? })` returns `{ repositories: [{ hostRepoId, fullPath, defaultBranch }] }`.
- All of these are in `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/web/src/pages/shell/bot-panel.tsx`:
  - lines 105–213: `BotSettings` component and queries.
  - lines 542–560: tabs; Advanced is `<TabsContent value="settings" … data-testid="bot-settings-advanced">`.
  - lines 586–595: lazy sections wrapped in `ErrorBoundary` + `Suspense`.
  - lines 761–805: the "Tools" group, an add-from-`NativeSelect` + rows-with-X pattern to mirror.
  - lines 934–952: the local `SettingsGroup` with `SectionHeading variant="label"`.
- `packages/contracts/src/bot-settings-layout.ts`: `BOT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS.advanced` order. Add `"repositories"` after `"skills"`. `packages/contracts/src/bot-settings-layout.test.ts` checks uniqueness. The mobile test `apps/mobile/lib/bot-settings-voice.test.tsx` (around line 720) only compares keys that have a label in its own `labels` map, so adding a key does not break it. Mobile rendering is a separate slice.
- `apps/web/src/pages/KnowledgeSection.tsx` (lines 74–155): query + mutation pattern (`useSpaceRpc`, `queries.x.queryOptions({ input })`, `fetchFresh`/`writeSaved`).
- `apps/web/src/lib/computer-sandbox.ts` (line 6): `computersAreUnavailable(sandboxProvider)`.
- `apps/web/src/components/ComputersUnavailableHint.tsx`: how `me.sandboxProvider` is read.
- `apps/web/src/components/integrations/space-availability.tsx`: `DropdownMenu` + `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` multi-select. Use it if a searchable menu fits better than `NativeSelect`.
- `apps/web/e2e/helpers.ts`: `openBotPanelTab(page, "Advanced")` (line 110), `signup`, `completeOnboarding`, `captureScreenshot`.
- `apps/web/e2e/messaging-settings.spec.ts`: RPC stubbing with `page.route`.

## Patterns to follow

**Section shell:**
```tsx
<ErrorBoundary fallback={<SectionLoadFailed />}>
  <Suspense fallback={null}>
    <RepositoriesSection botId={bot.id} />
  </Suspense>
</ErrorBoundary>
```
**Section body (inside `SettingsGroup label={t\`Repositories\`}`):**
- one row per bound repository: host icon or label, then `fullPath`, then an X button with the aria-label `Remove <fullPath>`.
- an add control (`aria-label="Add repository"`). It loads `codeHosts.connections.list`. For each connection it lazily loads `codeHosts.repositories.list` the first time the menu opens, and passes a `query` when the user types more than 2 characters, if it is searchable. It lists options as `<fullPath>`, grouped by connection label. Picking one calls `set` with the current list plus the new item.
- removing calls `set` without the item. Write the result with `writeSaved(queryClient, listOptions.queryKey, result)`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/web/src/pages/shell/RepositoriesSection.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the component as described. `data-testid="bot-repositories"` on the group and `data-testid="bot-repository-<fullPath>"` on each row.
  - Disabled state when `computersAreUnavailable(me.sandboxProvider)`: render the one-line message and nothing else interactive.
  - Server errors from `set` (NOT_FOUND etc.) show inline as the server message.
  - Optimistic updates are not required.
- **GOTCHA**: keep the list's identity stable. Key rows by `connectionId:hostRepoId`. `set` needs the full list, so build it from the latest query data, not from stale closure state.

### UPDATE `apps/web/src/pages/shell/bot-panel.tsx`
- **IMPLEMENT**: render the section in the Advanced tab at the position given by `BOT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS.advanced`, after Skills. Follow how the other advanced sections are ordered, for example through a map over `BOT_SETTINGS_ADVANCED_ORDER`.

### UPDATE `packages/contracts/src/bot-settings-layout.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add `"repositories"` after `"skills"` in `advanced`. Run the mobile test to confirm it stays green.

### Tests
- **E2E** `apps/web/e2e/bot-repositories.spec.ts`:
  - Stub `**/rpc/codeHosts/connections/list` (one GitLab connection), `**/rpc/codeHosts/repositories/list` (two repositories), `**/rpc/bots/repositories/list` (empty) and `**/rpc/bots/repositories/set` (echo back).
  - Steps: signup, completeOnboarding, open the bot panel, `openBotPanelTab(page, "Advanced")`. Expect the "Repositories" heading. Add `acme/docs`, and the row appears. Remove it, and the row disappears. `captureScreenshot(page, testInfo, "bot-repositories")`.
  - Second test: stub `me` (or the endpoint that supplies `sandboxProvider`) with `sandboxProvider: "none"`, and expect the text "This bot needs a computer to use repositories." with the add control absent or disabled.
- Add a web unit test if similar sections have them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The bot settings Advanced tab shows a "Repositories" group after Skills.
- [ ] Adding or removing a repository calls `bots/repositories/set` with the full list and re-renders from the response.
- [ ] With no computer, only "This bot needs a computer to use repositories." shows and nothing can be changed.
- [ ] With no connections, a "Connections" button opens `?settings=connections`.
- [ ] `BOT_SETTINGS_SECTIONS` includes `"repositories"`, and the contracts and mobile tests stay green.
- [ ] Tests pass: `pnpm test:e2e --spec=bot-repositories` and `pnpm vitest run packages/contracts/src/bot-settings-layout.test.ts apps/mobile/lib/bot-settings-voice.test.tsx`

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm lint && pnpm check
pnpm vitest run packages/contracts/src/bot-settings-layout.test.ts apps/mobile/lib/bot-settings-voice.test.tsx
pnpm test:e2e --spec=bot-repositories
```
